subject.title: [Feature]: Adopt dynamic exponential backoff for Channel Health Monitor

question: Should channel-health recovery adopt bounded per-account exponential backoff, and which observed healthy condition should reset its attempt level?
rationale: This changes the global balance between outage thrash and recovery latency, while the report does not define the maximum delay or reset contract needed to avoid slow recovery or ineffective backoff.

options.title: Bounded adaptive backoff
options.body: Increase the cooldown for consecutive unhealthy recoveries, cap it, and reset only after a confirmed healthy monitor pass.

options.title: Keep fixed cooldown
options.body: Retain the fixed cooldown and hourly cap unless real outage measurements demonstrate that the current limits remain too aggressive.

recommendation.title: Bounded adaptive backoff
recommendation.body: Increase the cooldown for consecutive unhealthy recoveries, cap it, and reset only after a confirmed healthy monitor pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the strongest sustained ownership of this monitor’s recovery and throttling policy.
